# 🐛 TEMPLATE SYSTEM BUG REPORT

**Generated by Comprehensive Template Tests**  
**Date**: Template system analysis  
**Status**: 🔴 CRITICAL - 4 significant bugs found in template system

## ❌ **TEMPLATE SYSTEM BUGS**

### BUG #1: Filter Functions Broken 🔴
- **Location**: `template/filters/index.js` furigana/kana filters
- **Issue**: Filter functions themselves don't work (not just template application)
- **Evidence**: `Filters.get('furigana')('漢字[かんじ]')` returns input unchanged
- **Expected**: `漢字[かんじ]` → `<ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>`
- **Actual**: `漢字[かんじ]` → `漢字[かんじ]` (no transformation)
- **Root Cause**: Regex patterns in filter functions may be incorrect
- **Impact**: All furigana/kana filters completely non-functional

### BUG #2: Null Field Array Handling 🔴
- **Location**: `template/index.js:25` in `_getField` method
- **Issue**: No null/undefined safety checks on field arrays
- **Error**: `Cannot read properties of null (reading '0')`
- **Impact**: Crashes when note has null/undefined fields array
- **Fix Needed**: Add safety check: `return (i !== undefined && f && f[i]) || ''`

### BUG #3: AST Parser Whitespace Handling ⚠️
- **Location**: `template/ast2.js` field name parsing
- **Issue**: Parser doesn't trim whitespace inside field braces
- **Evidence**: `{{ Front }}` → field name becomes `'Front '` (with trailing space)
- **Impact**: Field lookups fail due to whitespace mismatch
- **Fix Needed**: Trim field names: `name: m[1].slice(1).trim()`

### BUG #4: Extra Closing Block Handling ⚠️
- **Location**: `template/ast2.js` block parsing
- **Issue**: Extra closing blocks create malformed AST structure
- **Evidence**: `'Text{{/Front}}'` produces unexpected structure
- **Impact**: Template parsing may fail unpredictably
- **Fix Needed**: Graceful handling of unmatched closing blocks

- **Basic field substitution**: `{{Front}}` → field value

- **FrontSide integration**: `{{FrontSide}}` in back templates
- **Media URL tuning**: `_tune` method converts media references correctly
- **Template ordinal handling**: Multiple templates per bundle

### Filter System ✅
- **Filter registration**: `registerFilter()` works correctly
